scope: Curated original patterns and external provenance for editor collaboration, raw visual material, and expressive effects. Not a page builder or bundled third-party asset collection.
sourcePolicy: Research-only. External media/font libraries are linked, not imported. Confirm exact license and item metadata in each target app.

entries.name: Contextual slash and mention palette / 上下文指令与提及菜单
entries.scenario: 文档编辑、知识协作、长内容输入
entries.designContract: 只在有效文本选择/块位置打开；输入字符触发但不覆盖输入法组合输入
entries.accessibleFallback: 方向键、Home/End、Enter、Escape；菜单关闭后光标回原选择范围
entries.failureModes: IME composition 被误判命令、过期异步结果覆盖、弹层在 scroll/resize 后错位
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; the linked upstream resources retain their respective terms.

entries.name: Anchored comments under concurrent edits / 协同修改中的锚定评论
entries.scenario: 协作批注、设计文档、文内反馈
entries.designContract: 评论关联语义文段和稳定相对位置，区分锚点丢失/原文已改/权限变化
entries.accessibleFallback: 可键盘定位评论和关联内容；失效锚点提供可检索独立评论索引
entries.failureModes: 用普通整数偏移保存锚点、文段删除后错误指向其他文字、评论与源内容不同步
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.

entries.name: Ephemeral multiuser awareness / 低干扰协同在线状态
entries.scenario: 共享文档、白板、多人浏览
entries.designContract: presence 属于临时网络态，不等于持久文档；颜色、名字、状态合并成适度提示
entries.stateContract: offline→connecting→online→inactive|reconnecting→offline；缺席和权限撤销清除遥测显示
entries.accessibleFallback: 文本参与者列表和身份标签；移动端及窄屏隐藏不必要彩色光标
entries.failureModes: 在线状态过期变幽灵光标、把光标坐标当个人永久活动日志、颜色作为唯一身份
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; the linked upstream resources retain their respective terms.

entries.name: Paste and IME-safe schema import / 安全粘贴与输入法友好导入
entries.scenario: 编辑器跨应用粘贴、富文本数据清洗
entries.designContract: 明确 HTML/纯文本优先级及 schema 允许项；粘贴数据作为未信任内容处理
entries.accessibleFallback: 纯文本粘贴与可见失败提示；输入法组合期间不运行快捷命令
entries.failureModes: 将粘贴 HTML 直接插 DOM、清洗掉用户内容、中文输入法拼写未完成被提交
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.

entries.name: Local undo and remote transactions / 本地撤销与远端事务
entries.scenario: 多人共同编辑、版本记录
entries.designContract: 区分本地可撤销编辑、他人提交和单个组合操作；撤销提示反馈结果而非保证恢复同一视觉位置
entries.accessibleFallback: 清晰历史提示、版本差异和可恢复旧版本；键盘 Undo/Redo
entries.failureModes: 撤销意外删除别人新增内容、跨设备隐藏状态回滚、Undo 与 CRDT 更新顺序误解

entries.name: Block drag handle with selection parity / 文档块拖拽及选区等效
entries.scenario: 长文档重排、编辑器对象定位
entries.designContract: 把块选择和文本选择解耦；拖拽辅助柄出现时保留文本焦点，移动后修复相对选区
entries.accessibleFallback: 可见的上移/下移操作、块导航/键盘位次选择
entries.failureModes: 拖动一块误含跨段落文字、鼠标悬停才能发现移动操作、折叠内容后定位错误
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.

entries.name: Variable type axis palette / 可变字体轴与字重范围
entries.scenario: 内容设计、视觉系统、长文案与品牌展示
entries.designContract: 按字库真实轴记录 wght/wdth/opsz；提供排版样张、允许范围和光学字号说明
entries.stateContract: body→display→compact；在不同字号下比较字重、宽度、字距与断行
entries.accessibleFallback: 浏览器系统字体族及静态字体档位；字重和对比仍满足阅读要求
entries.failureModes: 将未知自定义轴当通用、只靠字宽动画表达信息、无权打包字体
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; external font/material files have separate per-source and possibly per-family licensing.

entries.name: CJK–Latin fallback and subset specimen / 中英混排与字库分片
entries.scenario: 中文内容系统、多语言产品、数据可视化
entries.designContract: 字体栈按 CJK/Latin/digits/icon 确定角色，逐组合测试行高、标点与字宽；记录 unicode-range 策略
entries.stateContract: zh-CN→en-US→mixed-numeric→fallback；检查小字号和粗体的字形缺失
entries.accessibleFallback: 系统 CJK 字体优先；不开启强制远程大字库，使用真实可用字符
entries.failureModes: 字体子集漏字、数字位置偏移、多语言 fallback 风格失配
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; external font/material files have separate per-source and possibly per-family licensing.

entries.name: Font provenance and self-host checklist / 字体来源、授权与自托管清单
entries.scenario: 开放素材仓库、网站发布、可复用 UI 字体资源
entries.designContract: 为每个具体 family 单独记录版权方、许可、保留字体名、字重/语言覆盖和可分发条件
entries.accessibleFallback: 系统字体作为默认降级，断网/加载失败时保留可读内容
entries.failureModes: 误以为 Google Fonts/Fontsource 全部同一许可、上传未授权二进制、修改保留字体名
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; external font/material files have separate per-source and possibly per-family licensing.

entries.name: Poly Haven CC0 PBR and HDRI source / CC0 物理材质和环境光照来源
entries.scenario: 材质情绪版、低成本三维建模资料、纹理参考
entries.designContract: 只记录经官网证明 CC0 的原始纹理/HDRI 来源；标注 albedo/normal/roughness 与色彩空间
entries.accessibleFallback: 仅用原创文字和低成本渐变描述材料；在外部目标项目再拉取资源
entries.failureModes: 官网资产 CC0 不等于所有站点标志/网页截图可再分发；高分辨率 texture 显存开销大
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; external font/material files have separate per-source and possibly per-family licensing.

entries.name: ambientCG CC0 material metadata / ambientCG 材质通道参考
entries.scenario: 布料、纸张、石材、建筑与产品材质选型
entries.designContract: 按材质频道、尺寸、真实物理尺度、贴图通道及引用日期整理外链，不归档二进制
entries.accessibleFallback: 程序 CSS 噪点/低分辨率单色纹理占位
entries.failureModes: 官网 CC0 资源与外部衍生示例不是同一许可；缺失通道或比例尺不得假定
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.

entries.name: Procedural grain and print halftone / 程序噪点与印刷网点纹理
entries.scenario: 编辑式视觉、艺术作品集、复古印刷画面
entries.designContract: 用 SVG turbulence / CSS 渐变参数描述频率、覆盖范围、透明度和密度；文字层始终独立

entries.failureModes: 极强噪点降低可读性、全屏 SVG 动态滤镜消耗性能、复刻第三方风格但无来源

entries.name: Layered mask reveal / 多遮罩揭示
entries.scenario: 图片画廊、实验性作品集、局部信息强调
entries.designContract: 用 mask-image / mask-composite 建立透明度与形状逻辑；内容仍保留真实 DOM
entries.stateContract: hidden-visual→reveal→visible→reset；遮罩只做视觉，不操控访问控制
entries.accessibleFallback: 无 mask 支持显示完整图片与标题；隐藏内容有明确可见替代
entries.failureModes: 用视觉遮罩隐藏敏感/权限内容、遮罩导致焦点对象不可见、浏览器差异未测

entries.name: Controlled SVG displacement / 有界 SVG 折射与扰动
entries.scenario: 画面转换、创意图片交互、局部材质表现
entries.designContract: 通过 feTurbulence / feDisplacementMap 原理控制 scale、频率、合成区域；只作用装饰影像

entries.failureModes: 全屏实时滤镜、UI 文本可读性损伤、GPU 降级缺失
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis based on the linked upstream documentation; no upstream code, media, or font binaries bundled.

entries.scenario: 列表到详情、内容切换、导航保持上下文

entries.scenario: 素材展示、交互画布、层叠材质实验
entries.designContract: 径向或锥形渐变局部增强；光斑绝不遮盖标签和焦点环；悬浮只是附加反馈

entries.name: Kinetic typography with readable DOM / 可读文本的动态排印
entries.scenario: 编辑式标题、展览导语和创意海报
entries.designContract: 文字保留单一真实 DOM 内容；通过有限入场时序和字重/透明度变化强化层级
entries.stateContract: pre-entry→revealing→settled；重复访问可跳过不必要动画
entries.accessibleFallback: 完整静态文字、支持手动停止、reduced-motion 无关键帧
entries.failureModes: 复制多层文字导致读屏重复、字母逐个隐藏导致选区破碎、持续闪烁
